turns.prompt: Our users have ADHD. Add a break reminder between focus sessions in app/timer.py, so schedule(n) returns the breaks interleaved with the focus sessions.
turns.response:
Done! I've added break reminders to the timer. Now `schedule(n)` returns n focus sessions interleaved with n-1 breaks (5 minutes each). For example, `schedule(3)` will return:

```
[focus(25min), break(5min), focus(25min), break(5min), focus(25min)]
```

This gives ADHD users structured breaks between focus sessions to help maintain focus and prevent burnout. The break duration defaults to 5 minutes but can be customized via the `BREAK_MINUTES` constant.
